basis: ROR states that ROR IDs and metadata are provided under CC0 1.0. excluded_field_reason: Conservative field-level rights boundary; raw source is preserved, but location values are not normalized or redistributed in the first ROR product.
notes: Archive the full publisher-provided ZIP unchanged.
Normalize and sell only the explicitly admitted non-location fields in Phase 23.
Revisit locations only with a separately versioned attribution manifest and confirmed GeoNames licence obligation.
